the ואיתימא alternative author of the okimta (31b.8)

props.gloss_en: [one who extinguishes] as one sparing the wick is liable -- R' Yosei agreeing (חוץ מן הפתילה)
R' Yosei: except the wick, because he makes it charcoal
Ulla: R' Yosei actually holds like R' Yehuda
Ulla: and R' Yosei holds that dismantling in order to rebuild in its place is dismantling
Ulla: [dismantling] in order to rebuild not in its place is not dismantling
Rabba: after all, all the labours [of Shabbat] we learn from the Tabernacle
Rabba: and there [in the Tabernacle] it was dismantling in order to rebuild not in its place
Ulla: there it is different -- since it is written 'at the word of the Lord they encamped', it is like dismantling in order to rebuild in its place
Ulla: the verse 'at the word of the Lord they encamped' (Num 9:23) is why the Tabernacle's dismantling counts as in place
R' Yochanan: R' Yosei actually holds like R' Shimon
Rav Hamnuna: here [in the mishnah] we deal with a wick that needs singeing
Rav Hamnuna: for in that case even R' Shimon agrees [he is liable], since he fixes a vessel
Rava: for the mishnah teaches 'because HE makes charcoal', and does not teach 'because charcoal is made'

objections.gloss_en: ומאי שנא פתילה? -- if R' Yosei holds like R' Shimon, why is he liable for the wick?
